title: Run Software Factory Phase 3b isolated-worktree parallel-builder proof
summary: Phase 3 ephemeral dispatch MVP proved bounded role dispatch, result collection, manual integration, independent gatekeeping, verifier feedback, and closure repair. The next control object is to prove isolated-worktree parallel-builder merge discipline before any larger scale-up.
